GLOBAL.headline: Global markets rebound: Dow climbs 200 pts as Fed signals interest rate cuts
GLOBAL.raw_text: Wall Street trade ended higher on Monday as soft inflation data reinforced hopes of a near-term Federal Reserve interest rate cut, prompting a global equities rally.
GLOBAL.summary: Dow rises 200 pts on Fed rate cut hopes, triggering global rally.

GLOBAL.headline: Brent Crude slips to $81/barrel amid rising US production levels
GLOBAL.raw_text: Crude oil prices softened, lowering fuel import costs for major consumers like India, boosting prospects for local logistics, auto, and aviation sectors.
GLOBAL.summary: Brent Crude slips to $81/bbl, benefiting oil importers like India.

RELIANCE.headline: Reliance Retail steps up expansion, signs global cosmetic JV
RELIANCE.raw_text: Reliance Retail expands premium lifestyle footprint with new global brand acquisitions, setting targets to double regional margins over next fiscal cycle.
RELIANCE.summary: Reliance Retail signs global cosmetic JV to drive premium lifestyle segment expansion.

RELIANCE.headline: Reliance Industries shuts down secondary refining unit for regular maintenance
RELIANCE.raw_text: The refining unit shutdown is anticipated to last 10 days, though overall export volumes are buffered by high inventory reserves.
RELIANCE.summary: Reliance refining unit shut for 10 days for routine maintenance; backup inventory handles exports.

TCS.headline: TCS wins massive $800M digital transformation contract with UK retail giant
TCS.raw_text: Tata Consultancy Services secured a multi-year IT integration and platform migration contract, driving positive sector analyst sentiment.
TCS.summary: TCS bags $800M contract with UK retailer, boosting IT sector sentiment.

HDFCBANK.headline: HDFC Bank records 18% credit growth YoY in Q1 preliminary figures
HDFCBANK.raw_text: Deposit accretion picked up pace, narrowing the credit-to-deposit gap post-merger. Capital adequacy ratios remain highly robust.
HDFCBANK.summary: HDFC Bank posts strong 18% YoY Q1 credit growth with robust deposits accretion.

HDFCBANK.headline: RBI imposes minor penalty on HDFC Bank over compliance disclosures
HDFCBANK.raw_text: A nominal administrative penalty of INR 1.5 Crores was levied, which management clarified has no material operational or financial impact.
HDFCBANK.summary: RBI levies a minor penalty of INR 1.5 Crores on HDFC Bank over compliance disclosures.

ZOMATO.headline: Zomato Blinkit gross order values double as quick-commerce adoption spikes
ZOMATO.raw_text: Zomato shares hit record highs as profitability metrics improve in the quick commerce vertical, prompting broker upgrades.
ZOMATO.summary: Zomato Blinkit GOV doubles on rapid quick-commerce adoption, driving stock upgrades.

SUZLON.headline: Suzlon secures massive 300 MW wind energy project in Gujarat
SUZLON.raw_text: The order involves installing 95 wind turbine generators, with commissioning set for late next year, strengthening their order book.
SUZLON.summary: Suzlon bags 300 MW wind power order in Gujarat, expanding wind pipeline.
